mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Development and testing that need a certificate the system doesn't already trust use self-signed certificates, with verification left on, rather than turning verification off. The project also records a decision to use https everywhere with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
